# LLM Packages & Tools

## Tools

-   [Prodigy](https://prodi.gy/): data annotation tool
-   [Numerous AI](https://numerous.ai/): extract text, categorize, generate formulas, and use ChatGPT right inside your spreadsheet
-   [GraphGPT](https://github.com/varunshenoy/GraphGPT): converts unstructured natural language into a knowledge graph
-   [HuggingChat](https://huggingface.co/chat/)
